title: Compliance score calculation returns a deterministic value for identical mapping input, not a randomized placeholder
description: Guards against a known anti-pattern class in this codebase (see Policy_Management QA coverage note on 'compliance dashboard authenticity — Math.random() fake scores') by asserting the score function is pure and deterministic.
preconditions: Compliance score utility called in isolation with a fixed control-mapping fixture
steps: Call the compliance score calculator twice with an identical set of control mappings and statuses
expectedResult: Both calls return the exact same numeric score — confirms the score is computed from real mapping data, not randomized.

title: compareVersions() field diff correctly reports changed, added, and removed fields between two policy versions
steps: Call compareVersions with version 1 = {title:'A', body:'X'} and version 2 = {title:'A', body:'Y', owner:'Bob'}
expectedResult: Diff reports 'body' as changed (X->Y) and 'owner' as added, 'title' as unchanged.

title: Bulk delete validation rejects a request that includes any policy currently in 'active' status
description: Route-level v.bulkOperation validation plus controller logic for POST /policies/bulk should reject bulk-deleting active/approved policies without an explicit archive-first step.
steps: Call the bulk operation validator/handler with a mixed batch of policy IDs where one policy is 'active' and the operation is 'delete'
expectedResult: The active policy is excluded from the delete with a per-item error, or the whole batch is rejected — an active policy is never silently deleted via bulk operations.

title: getRequirementMappings returns an empty array (not an error) for a policy with no mapped requirements
steps: Call getRequirementMappings for a policy with zero entries in its requirement-mappings collection
expectedResult: Returns 200 with an empty array, not a 404 or 500.
